assets.story-world: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: website hero illustration for Story Bible, a narrative canon and impact QA tool for game studios. Primary request: a quiet editorial pencil-and-ink drawing of an open story ledger, its pages becoming a small original fictional coastal world: a lighthouse on a rocky islet, a few rooflines, a winding path, with three small connected index cards beside the ledger. One sharpened pencil rests on the left, a capped fountain pen on the right. The image suggests a writer tracing how parts of a story connect. Style: precise fine graphite lines, restrained Prussian blue ink, light crosshatching, tiny muted ochre accents, warm ivory page interiors. Flat hand-drawn editorial illustration, no 3D, no gradients, no photorealism. Composition: wide 3:2, compact centered vignette with generous transparent breathing room and fully visible objects, balanced, designed to remain clear at 450 pixels wide. Transparent background, true alpha. Constraints: entirely original, no characters, no brands, no letters, no words, no numbers, no readable writing, no watermarks; any page markings are only short abstract strokes. Do not draw a fake UI.
